password.title: Password / App Password
password.description: For Nextcloud: Create an app password in the security settings

deleteCompletedTasks.title: Delete completed tasks from calendar
deleteCompletedTasks.description: When enabled, completed tasks are automatically removed from the calendar

addReminders.title: Add reminders (alarms) to calendar events
addReminders.description: Adds a notification/alarm to timed events so Nextcloud and your phone remind you

reminderMinutesBefore.title: Reminder lead time (minutes before)
reminderMinutesBefore.description: 0 = remind at the task's scheduled time (matches Super Productivity). e.g. 10 = notify 10 minutes before.
